articles.headline: Clark scores 19 and No. 6 Texas remains undefeated with a 96-45 win over Southeastern Louisiana

article.headline: Carnegie scores 17 of her 19 in 1st half, No. 8 Iowa women cruise after halftime to beat Navy 104-48
article.description: — Dani Carnegie scored 17 of her 19 points in the first half, McKenna Woliczko added 18 points and No. 8 Iowa pulled away after halftime to beat Navy 104-48 on Wednesday in the Baha Mar Pink Flamingo Championship.
article.linkText: Carnegie scores 17 of her 19 in 1st half, No. 8 Iowa women cruise after halftime to beat Navy 104-48
article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — Dani Carnegie scored 17 of her 19 points in the first half, McKenna Woliczko added 18 points and No. 8 Iowa pulled away after halftime to beat Navy 104-48 on Wednesday in the Baha Mar Pink Flamingo Championship. Iowa's lead was just 50-38 at halftime before outscoring Navy 34-6 in the third quarter and 20-4 in the fourth. The Midshipmen were held to 2-of-36 shooting in the second half — with six points coming from the free-throw line. Iowa started the third by scoring 15 straight points, capped by Woliczko’s layup for a 65-38 lead. After Navy made its first basket of the second half following five straight misses, Iowa scored the next six points for a 31-point lead. Navy was 1 of 17 from the field in the third and 1 of 19 in the fourth. The Midshipmen did not make their field goal of the fourth until eight seconds left in the game. Ava Heiden had 13 points and 12 rebounds, and Taylor Stremlow also scored 13 points off the bench for Iowa (7-1), which has won five straight. Journey Houston added 10 points off the bench. Zoe Mesuch scored 19 points and Zanai Barnett-Gay added 17 for Navy (4-4), which entered following a 72-51 loss to Toledo in its tournament opener. Woliczko, Carnegie and Chazadi Wright each made a 3-pointer in the opening two minutes of the second quarter to put Iowa ahead by double digits. Carnegie made four of Iowa’s eight 3-pointers in the first half. Seven of Navy’s 11 baskets came from 3-point range to stay close. The Hawkeyes have held seven of their eight opponents below 70 points. Up next Navy: Returns home to play Old Dominion on Monday.
